title: The New Noodle Casserole
description: A performance-oriented noodle casserole with beef or turkey, bulgur, and dairy, approved by sport dietitians.

instructions.text: Coat a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. While simmering pan ingredients below, cook noodles until just tender (6 to 8 min.). Drain and rinse under cold water.
Separate white and green parts of scallions; thinly slice and keep separately.
Cook beef in a large pan or skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up clumps with a wooden spoon, until no longer pink (3 to 5 min.). Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess fat.

Wipe out pan with paper towel, add oil and reduce heat to medium-low. Add bulgur, garlic and the scallion whites. Cook and stir until the scallions soften (5 to 7 min.). Add tomato sauce, water and the beef; bring to a simmer. Cover and simmer until the bulgur is tender and the sauce is thickened (15 to 20 min.). Season with salt and pepper.
Puree cottage cheese until smooth. Transfer to a medium bowl; stir in sour cream and scallion greens.
Layer half of the noodles, half the cottage cheese mixture and half the meat sauce in the baking dish. Repeat with the remaining ingredients. Sprinkle Cheddar over the top.
Bake casserole until bubbly, 30 to 40 min. Let stand for 10 min. before serving.
